Hi Lena — looping in brief VAT guidance so procurement can confirm expectations.

Summary:
- For the EU legal entity (Rainbow EU Ltd, VAT GB999999973): Redwood must either
  a) show VAT per EU-entity row on the invoice so Rainbow EU Ltd can reclaim VAT, or
  b) if Redwood invoices a non-EU entity, Rainbow will need to account for reverse charge (not ideal here).
- Because you have a dedicated EU legal entity, I recommend issuing a separate invoice to Rainbow EU Ltd that contains the VAT line and their VAT registration number on the header. That minimizes manual reclaim steps.
- For the US and APAC entities: no VAT; please provide the exact tax IDs (EIN/UEN) to include on the invoice headers.

If you want consolidated invoice (single invoice number) we can still include VAT lines per row, but your AP will need the CSV to import and create vendor-specific accounting entries.

Also: please confirm whether Rainbow prefers three separate supplier/vendor records in Redwood for automated bookkeeping or a single vendor with entity sub-IDs — we can support either.
